title: 企鹅站在冰上为什么不冷
subtitle: 三层保暖，外加挤在一起
character: wearing a red puffer jacket, dark blue jeans and grey boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil with visible hatching strokes and layered shading, ice blue, slate grey and pale gold

pages.zh:
玻璃后面是一块冰，
几只企鹅站在上面。
冰凉得直冒白气，
它们光着两只脚，
却一点也不缩。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy in a warm jacket at a zoo window, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, wondering; behind the glass two penguins stand on a slab of ice.

pages.zh:
企鹅身上有三层。
最外面是羽毛，
羽毛底下压着空气，
皮底下还藏着
厚厚的一层脂肪。

它的羽毛又短又硬，
一根压着一根，
密得像鱼鳞一样。
巴掌那么大一块皮，
能长出上千根来。
pages.scene: Close view of a patch of penguin skin on a cream background, short stiff feathers overlapping each other like tiles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
羽毛根上还带着绒。
绒把空气兜住了，
空气不爱传热，
就成了一层被子，
盖在它的皮上面。

它的尾巴根上
有一个小油腺。
它用嘴蘸一点油，
从头到脚抹一遍，
水就沾不上身了。
pages.scene: One penguin turning its head back to touch the base of its tail with its beak on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
腿里的血管很怪，
往下的和往上的
紧紧贴在一块儿。
热还没走到脚上，
就被带回去了。

所以它的两只脚
只比冰暖一点点。
脚上没有多少热，
底下的冰就化不了，
它也站得稳稳的。
pages.scene: Close view of two penguin feet standing on a slab of ice on a cream background, the ice under them still dry and unmelted. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
天最冷的时候，
几千只挤成一团。
外面一圈顶着风，
里面的暖烘烘的，
挨着挨着就热了。

挤久了怎么办呢？
外圈的往里钻，
里圈的被挤到外面，
一圈一圈慢慢转，
轮流站在最外面。
pages.scene: A huddle of many penguins packed tightly together in blowing snow on a cream background, the ones on the outside leaning into the wind. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
团里面有多暖和？
比外面高出好多。
挤在中间的企鹅
有时候还嫌热，
自己挪到边上去。

公企鹅更辛苦。
蛋放在脚背上，
肚皮垂下来盖住，
一站就是两个月，
风再大也不挪窝。
pages.scene: One male emperor penguin standing still in the snow on a cream background, a single egg resting on top of his feet and a fold of belly skin hanging over it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我哈了一口气，
玻璃上起了白雾。
擦干净再看过去，
它还光着两只脚，
稳稳地站在冰上。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy wiping a patch of fog off the zoo window with his mitten, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling; a penguin stands on ice beyond the glass.
